title: catha europaea
intro: Catha europaea, commonly known as khat, is a flowering plant native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. The leaves of the khat plant have been used for centuries for their medicinal and stimulant properties, providing health benefits such as reducing fatigue, improving mental clarity, and aiding in weight loss. The therapeutic actions of khat include its ability to increase alertness, boost mood, and provide pain relief, although its effects can be short-lived and may lead to addiction. The bioactive constituents of khat include alkaloids like cathinone and cathine, which contribute to its stimulating and psychoactive effects.
